sources.title: Build your BYD SEALION 7 (online configurator)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. The maker URL redirected to evdealergroup-byd.com.au, BYD Australia's online order platform (the same route the 14 October packet recorded). Model list as displayed: SEALION 7 Premium $54,990; SEALION 7 Performance $63,990. Prices are the vehicle subtotal before on-road costs; an order fee is taken at order. Allocation, physical stock and delivery date are not stated.
